description: Ministry of Housing and Construction - Regulations made by the Minister of Housing  & Construction under section 43 of the Rent Act No. 7 of 1972 read with sub section (5) Section 2 of the said act was published in the Gaz. Exord. No. 1978/4 dated 01.08.2016 has been approved by the parliament on 26th November, 2016
reasoning: The gazette content primarily concerns the approval of regulations made under the Rent Act, No. 7 of 1972. This involves a legal/regulatory matter (subsidiary legislation under an existing Act) and not government personnel, structure, or any of the other specialized categories like land or commercial matters. While a Minister is named, the core content is the regulatory action, not the appointment of the person or a description of their portfolio responsibilities.
